news.title: Overheid stopt 1 miljoen in Skytree voor CO2-project met Direct Air Capture
Skytree krijgt €1 miljoen voor CO₂ uit de lucht in IJsland
Skytree krijgt €1 miljoen om in IJsland CO₂ uit de lucht te halen
Nieuwsupdate: Skytree gaat internationaal met CO2-project IJsland
Skytree secures €1m Dutch development loan for Iceland DAC project
Skytree lands €1 million to take its air-captured CO₂ to Iceland

summary: Skytree is official nickname for part of the Tobu Isesaki Line in Japan, founded in 2012. Type: startup / scale-up. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 2 about funding.

insights.one_liner: Skytree is a Dutch startup that captures CO2 from the air; it is an IND recognised sponsor and just landed €1 million for an Iceland project.

culture.text: A Dutch company building machines that capture carbon dioxide directly from the air.
Its CEO says available CO2 is getting more expensive while its machines keep getting cheaper.

open.text: Skytree B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one open job here, a sales internship in Amsterdam, does not require Dutch and mentions visas.

growth.text: Secured a €1 million Dutch government development loan for a direct air capture project in Iceland.
Launched a crowdfunding raise to scale its direct air capture technology.

worth_knowing.text: The Iceland project is described as Skytree's step into international markets.
